conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m Ilyra from Duncastle Auto — we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for our policyholders. It’s showing outdated figures even after we re-synced the integrations.
Thanks for reaching out, Ilyra. Let me check your account’s reporting module and see if there’s a sync lag or a role-based permission issue blocking the updated reserves data.
Appreciate the quick response. We’ve double-checked the roles and tasks assigned — everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.
Understood. I’ll run a manual refresh on your reporting pipeline and verify the supplier data feed. Could you confirm if any new claims or payments were processed since the last successful sync?
Yes — we logged three new claims and two supplier payments yesterday. The documents for those are all uploaded and tagged correctly in the system.

Got it. I’ll force a rebuild of the reserves calculation based on those new entries and send you a test report by 3 PM. Let me know if you’d like to schedule a screen share to walk through the adjustments.
That would be helpful — maybe tomorrow morning? We’re preparing for an audit and need everything locked down by Friday.
I’ll block 10 AM tomorrow for you. I’ll also email a summary of the changes made to the reserves and confirm the updated reporting is visible in your dashboard before we meet.
